critical_fix.bug: Subtitles only changed on scene/page changes because the subtitles filter was applied before static images were expanded into a 30fps stream.
critical_fix.fix: Apply fps=30 before subtitles in the video filter graph.

subtitle_sync_strategy.reason: Scene-scoped request chunks reduce API calls while subtitle timings are estimated inside each real chunk duration.

visual_frame_generation.actual_artifact: Static PNG scene cards generated by Pillow, then converted to video by ffmpeg.

ai_reuse_instruction.if_user_provides_copy: Convert the copy into a JSON file matching workflow/scene_input.schema.json, then run make_video.py with --input.
do_not: Do not edit subtitle timings manually unless validating a rendering bug.
Do not remove fps=30 before subtitles.
Do not rely on Edge TTS WordBoundary for final subtitle line timing.
